239)༄༅/rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa'i snyen pa'i kha skong du sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/thog mar gang du bya bar sa mchog mdor bsdus pa ni/dkar gta

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa'i snyen pa'i kha skong du sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ thog mar gang du bya bar sa mchog mdor bsdus pa ni/ dkar gtor/ gser skyems/ dri bzang dang ba byung gi chu/ thig tshon sogs 'du byas la/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba dra byaṃ shwa dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las= sogs nas/ bdag zhu khyed kyis bstsol du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar gyis sngon gtor dang*/ rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud ser skyems gtang*/ rdo rje lag g.yas par bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa a/ zhes pa'i rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bzlas nas stong nyid du rgyas gdab/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis ba byung dang dri bzang gis chag chag g.yas bskor du gdab/ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka rang nyid rdor sems su gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams sogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ oṃ swa aṃ ha/ zhes pa'i sngags zlo bzhin du thig gdab/ tshon rnams rdor sems yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams= sogs nas/ rdul phra rab tu gyur/ gong ltar 'bru gsum dang*/ rigs lnga'i sa bon brgya rtsa brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la bkye'o/ dngos bzhi la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ rgyud 'debs/ bsang chu sgrub pa/ dkar bgegs/ tshogs bsag nas bdag skyed/ bzlas pa/ gsol gdab/ bsdu rim/ stong nyid kyi ngang du gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes pas lhar ldang*/ de nas rdo rje bzung la/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ dril bu dkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe āḥ rdor dril 'khyud rgya bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba 240) at+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ swa bha ba= sogs nas/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ bar gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ sbyin sreg gzhung gi oṃ swa hā= sogs lan gsum re btang ba nas/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas rdzas rnams la reg bzhin du/ rdzas so so'i rnam par gsal bar gyur/

zhes pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa lan gsum/ 'og gi rdzas sngags/ oṃ bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swa hā/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod nas/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swa hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i bar gong du blang*/ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la ram̐ gyis me sbar/ hūm̐ hūm̐= gis rlung g.yab/ oṃ ag+ne swa hā sa mar khu 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ oṃ ku sha = sogs nas/ mdzad du gsol/ swa hā sa ku sha dgram/ ma hā kro dhi= swa bhā ba= stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las= sogs nas/ me lha skyed pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ du mas bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ gis 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs par gyur/ lag g.yas kyi mthe bong g.yab cing*/ oṃ tshur gshegs sogs spyan 'dren tshig brjod nas/ sngags/ a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ yi rjes su las sngags/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba dra byam sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bgegs bskrad/ oṃ ag+ne de bya= sogs mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ gzhug bstim dang dgang blug 'dzin bzhin/ me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ mar khu sngags grangs 'bul bzhin du/ oṃ ag+ne ye swa hā/ lan bdun mthar/ ag+ne ye de bya= sogs dang*/ 241)༄༅/ bdag cag dpon slob= sogs nas/ mdzad du gsol/ bar lan gsum gyis dgang blug nyer gcig song nas mchod bstod dang*/ rdzas phud blangs nas yam shing*/ oṃ bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swa hā/ lan bdun rjes/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la= sogs 'dod gsol tshar gcig de 'dra bas mar khu/ til/ zho zan/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūrba/ ku sha bcas bdun re rdzogs nas/ ag+ne ye de bya= sogs tshar bdun gyis rdzas spungs 'bul yang chog yang*/ ag+ne ye de bya= tshar gcig gis yungs dkar thab tu dor/ drang srong chen po= sogs nas/ dz+wa la raṃ gyis mar khu gzar bus g.yas skor gyis shar lhor blugs nas/

me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes dang*/ ma hā kro dhi sa bsang*/ shu n+ya ta stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi dbus su e las nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor sogs mdun skyed ltar blangs nas/ spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur/ phyag nas gzung*/ bstod pa'i bar du gtang*/ dgang blugs 'dzin bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor kyi lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ lan bdun/ yig brgya tshar gcig yang yig drug lan bdun/ yig brgya tshar gcig yang yig drug bdun/ yig brgya gcig gi dgang blugs nyer gcig song nas/ rdzas 'bul ba la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ lan gcig oṃ bau dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swa hā/ tshar bcu/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la= sogs 'dod gsol tshar gcig de 'dra bas/ mar khu/ til/ zho zan/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ 242) gro/ dūrba/ ku sha bcas bcu re rdzogs pas sbyin sreg tshar brgya song ba yin/ yang yam shing*/ mar khu/ nas/ ku sha yan tshar bcu re bzla/ de 'dra ba tshar bcu grub pas sbyin sreg stong phrag gcig 'gro ba yin/ snyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg la gong du bshad pa'i so so ba brgya tsam song rjes/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ kho nas rdzas spungs 'bul/ stong phrag snyen pa'i bcu cha ma 'gro bar grangs 'dzin dgos pas thun re re bzhin sbyin sreg gi mgo mtha' tshang bar gtong dgos/ de nas mtha' bsdu ba ni yig brgya tshar gcig bdag cag dpon slob= nas/ mdzad du gsol/ bar yungs dkar 'bul/ de nas byon skyems/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ lan bdun/ yig brgya tshar gcig gis 'bul ba de 'dra lan gsum gyis byon skyems nyer gcig song nas/ bdag skyed ltar/ gtsang dme'i dri rtog= sogs dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi'i= sogs kyis lha gzhung sreg gtor 'bul/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra satwa ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha= sogs kyis mchod/ mi rtog rdo rje= sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma rnyed yongs su=

sogs dang*/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la ram̐ gyis mar khu shar lho nas bskor ste dkyil 'khor du blug slar yang me lha cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ dgang blug oṃ ag+ne ye swa hā/ lan bdun/ oṃ ag+ne ye de bya= sogs dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob= sogs nas/ mdzad du gsol/ bar lan gsum gyis dgang blug nyer gcig dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swa hā/ lan bdun/ bzi brjid phun sum tshogs 243) pa la= lan gcig sbyar ba/ nas/ ku sha yan bdun re rdzogs nas/ oṃ ag+ne ye a ka ro= sogs btags pas me lha'i gtor ma phul/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe= sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod/ bar dang*/ yig brgya lan gcig ma rnyed yongs su= sogs dang*/ bdag gi don dang= sogs nas/ gats+tsha/ rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ a ka ros dung zhal gyi 'o mas me gzhil/ las gzhung ltar/ bla ma yi dam= sogs kyis bsngo smon dang*/ byin rlabs mchog stsol = sogs bkra shis bcas brjod pas grub bo/ ro sreg byed na/ rdor sems gzhung chog gnas 'dren gyi lam bstan yan grub nas/ ro la gnas lung ltar/ zhi sbyong*/ phyed ma/ drag sbyong bcas dang*/ til sbyong mi dgos/ yig brgya dang*/ da ha= sogs kyis bye yungs brab/ khrus gsol/ sku phyi bcas/ bdag skyed ltar/ shu n+ya ta= 'khor 'das chos kun= sogs nas/ mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bar gyis ro rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba la mchod bstod bcas grub nas/ sbyin sreg la 'jug me sbar/ ag+ne dz+wa la'i= sngags kyi gong du gnas lung g-i me sbar/ dkyil 'khor 244) gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka= sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi thab khung=

sogs sbyor ba las 'don lugs gzhan gong bshad ltar bya/ sbyin sreg tshar nas tshogs drang ba man mthar dbyung*/ sgrub mchod dang sbyin sreg sbrel lugs gzhung dang sgrub khog las gsal ba ltar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang bla ma o rgyan dpal 'byor gyi nyams bzhes gsal byed du thub bstan chos kyi glang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
